title: Factor-Closure of Pro-Nilsystems via Local Rigidity of Nilsystems
summary: Pro-nilsystems arise naturally in ergodic theory through the study of multiple ergodic averages. The Host-Kra structure theorem implies that every factor of an ergodic $s$-step pro-nilsystem is again an $s$-step pro-nilsystem. No proof of this fact independent of the structure theorem was previously known. In this thesis, we give such a proof, using only arguments intrinsic to nilsystems. The main new ingredient is a local rigidity result for self-joinings of nilsystems: every ergodic self-joining sufficiently close to the diagonal joining is necessarily the graph joining of an automorphism.…
